QuestInfo.name: Homecoming Queen Bee Event
QuestInfo.0: Chief Stan is worried about all the bees in Henesys for their Homecoming Day. There are beehives all over Henesys Park!
QuestInfo.1: Get rid of the beehives and the Queen Bee in Henesys.
QuestInfo.2: You got rid of the beehives and Queen Bee in Henesys, and got a reward from Chief Stan.
